design_direction.name: Night Run Telemetry
design_direction.summary: A dark editorial driving guide with acid-lime wayfinding, condensed motorsport typography, a CSS-built night highway scene, and fact status labels that make the starter route easy to scan.

information_architecture.label: Hero
information_architecture.purpose: Orient the player and route them to the on-site beginner guide before any external play link.

information_architecture.label: First 10 Minutes
information_architecture.purpose: Five-step starter route based on approved game identity, group boost, code redemption, vehicle types, and play modes.

information_architecture.label: Current Code
information_architecture.purpose: Show the time-scoped official-description code and redemption steps with expiry cautions.

information_architecture.label: Choose Your Line
information_architecture.purpose: Summarize approved driving, racing, exploring, and meetup activities.

information_architecture.label: Cash Boosts
information_architecture.purpose: Compare the approved 25% community and 50% VIP claims without asserting price or stacking.

information_architecture.label: Common Mistakes
information_architecture.purpose: Warn about code capitalization, whitespace, expiry, and unsourced specifics.

information_architecture.label: FAQ
information_architecture.purpose: Answer identity, code menu, failure, VIP, and vehicle-choice questions concisely.

time_scoped_claims: The 960,000-like next milestone is labeled as the value shown at the time of checking.
omitted_claims: Discord as a typical code-posting source

implementation.styling: CSS custom properties and responsive component styles
accessibility: decorative illustration labeled without relying on color alone
